reviews.title: Perfect Upgrade for My Laptop
reviews.comment: The Crucial 16GB memory was exactly what I needed for my Acer laptop. Easy to install fit perfectly and it made a noticeable difference in performance. No problems with compatibility at all.  Very happy with this purchase.
reviews.author: Nicole Joshua

reviews.title: Good ram, good price, lasts forever
reviews.comment: As advertised, but lemme tell you i bought this stick of ram years ago and its still powering laptops i use as servers and auxiliary systems. I bought this back when my main laptop used DDR4 of this type. Still works, lasts a good while, and decently fast too. Basically, works to spec, obviously its not lightning fast because it didnt claim to be, it is as it is supposed to be
reviews.author: Ramen

reviews.title: Excellent brand-name memory for laptop
reviews.comment: Worked as expected and I trust the brand name. Easy to install and upgrade my laptop. Would have preferred more substantial packaging for mailing but internal package for the memory was solid.
reviews.author: Sparty

reviews.title: Great Value Upgrade. Quick Install, Noticeable Speed Increase
reviews.comment: I upgraded my Lenovo P16s by replacing the 8GB memory module with this 16GB one. The installation was easy, worked without any issues, and my system now has 24GB total RAM — multitasking is noticeably faster.
reviews.author: YC
